chapter.verse: Ka mite aw, keima hilhna ngai un la, ka kam tawh ka thugente na bil uh hong ngat un!
Note tungah thu kong gen ding hi. I pu i pate in hong gensa, eite in i zaksa leh i theihsa, taanglai-a thuthukte kong genkhia ding hi.
Hih thute, i tate tungah eite in im loin, hong piang ding khangthakte tungah, Topa ’ minthang nasepna, ama vangliatna leh ama sepsa nalamdangte i gen ding hi.

Amaute pen Pasian’ tunga lungsim thuman lo, lungsim kip a nei lo khang mi, lungsim khauh-in a lehdo khang mite ahi, amau’ pate tawh kibang loin, amaute in Pasian’ sungah amau lametna koihin, Pasian’ nasepnate mangngilh loin, ama thupiakte zui-in, a suak nai lo naupangte, hong piang kik khangthakte in a thute thei-in, amaute dingkhia-in amau’ tu leh tate tungah a thute a gen theih nadingin, amah in i pate in a tate a hilh sawn dinga a sawl ahi, Israel sungah thukham khat koihin, Jakob sungah teci pan’na khat a koih hi.
Thal a tawi Efraim mite in gal kido ni-in nungkik uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian’ thuciamna zui lo uh a, ama thukham bangin gamta nuam lo uh hi.
Ama bawlsa leh amau tunga nalamdang a lahsate amaute in mangngilh uh hi.
Izipt gamsung, Zoan mun-ah, a pu a pate uh’ muhna-ah amah in nalamdang a bawl hi.
Amah in tuipi khenkhia-in amaute kantansak a, tuite a lompi-in omsak hi.
Sun hunin amah in amaute meiipi khat tawh kha a, zan tawntung, meikuang taang khat tawh a kha hi.
Amah in gamsung ah suangpite kitamsak a, tui thukpi sung pan-a piangkhia bangin amaute tungah tuidawn ding tampi pia hi.
Amah in suangpi sung panin luitui luangkhia sak a, gunte bangin tuite luangsak hi.
Ahi zongin ama tungah amaute khial lailai uh a, sehnel gam sungah Sang Penpa lehpan’ uh hi.
Amau’ duh mahmah an kalhna tawh amaute in a lungsim sung uh-ah Pasian ze-et uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian gensia uh a, “Pasian in gamlakah sabuai phah thei ding ahi hiam?
Amah in suangpi sat a, tui lengkhia-in luite dimlet takpi ahi hiam? Amah in ama mite, an ahi a, sa-meh ahi zongin a pia thei takpi ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in a zak ciangin hehna tawh kidim-in, meikuang tawh Jakob sugawp a, Israel tungah ama hehna khang hi;
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Pasian um lo uh a, ama hotkhiat vangliatna muang lo uh hi.
Ahi zongin amah in, tung-a om vantungte thu pia-in, vantung kongte hong a,
nek dingin amau tungah manna kici an zusak-in, amaute vantung an na pia hi.
Mihingte in vantungmite’ an ne a, amah in amaute tungah an tampi puak hi.
Amah in vantungah nisuahna huih nungsak-in, ama vangliatna tawh leitaw lam huih paikhiatpih a,
amah in amaute tungah leivui zah bangin sa zusak a, tuipi sehnel zah bangin vasa kha neite zusak hi;
amah in amau giahphual laizang, amau omna kiim khempeuhah tuate kiasak hi.
Amah in amau’ duhpen pia ahih manin, amaute in ne-in gilvah uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in a duhpen uh a kham ma, amau kam sungah an om laipi mahin,
amau tungah Pasian’ hehna tung kikin amah in amau lak pan-a a hatpente that-in, Israel sung pan-a a kitengkhia mite niamkoihsuk hi.
Hih nalamdangte khempeuh om napi-in amaute khial lai veve uh a, ama nalamdangte hangin amaute in um tuan lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in amau nite, husan’ bangin maimangsak a, amau nuntakna, launa lianpi tawh beisak hi.
Amah in amaute a thah ciangin amaute in amah zong a, amaute kisikin, lungsim taktak tawh Pasian zong uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian pen, amau tankhiapa Sangpen Pasian, a suangpi uh ahihna phawk uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in a kam uh tawh amah phat khem uh a, a lei uh tawh ama tungah zuau gen uh hi.
Amau lungsim uh ama lamah kip lo a, ama thuciamna-ah amaute thuman lo hi.
Ahi zongin, amah in hehpihna lungsim nei ahih manin amau khialhnate maisak a, amaute susia lo hi; amah in a hehna iip zelzel a, a hehna khempeuh phongkhia lo hi.
Amah in, amaute pen mihing hi lel a, hong paikik nawn lo huih nung bang ahihna uh phawk hi.
Amaute in gam lakah amah lehdo zelzelin, sehnel gam sungah amah dahsak uh hi!
Amaute in amah ze-et kikkik uh a, Israelte’ Siangtho Pa phin uh hi.
Amaute in, galte kiang panin a tatkhiat ni uh hi taleh, Izipt gamah ama limte a bawl hun hi taleh, Zoan gam-a ama nalamdangte hi taleh, ama vangliatna hi taleh, ngaihsutin nei lo uh hi.
Amaute in a luituite uh a dawn theih loh nadingin amau gunte amah in sisan a suaksak hi.
Amah in, amaute a pet thei cippi honte leh amau’ lote a susia uiphukte amau lakah a sawl hi.
Amah in, amau’ lo ante tangngol pia a, amau sepna gahte kauphe pia hi.
Amah in, a leengguite uh gial tawh denggawp a, a theithekte uh vukkhal tawh susia hi.
Amah in, a ganhingte uh gial tawh denglum a, a gankhawite uh keek tawh denglum hi.
Amah in, amaute tungah a lauhuai ama sinsona, hehna, thangpaihna, gimna, a susia thei vantungmi honkhat khah hi.
Amah in, a sin sona ip lo a, kuamah hin’ khawilo a, pulnatna tawh amaute sisak hi.
Ham’ suante inn sunga ta upa teng ahi, Izipt gam sunga naucil khempeuh amah in vatmai hi.
Tua ciangin amah in tuu bangin ama mite paikhiatpih a, gam lakah ganhon bangin amaute lam lak hi.
Amah in muan’huaina mun-ah amaute paipih ahih manin amaute lau lo uh hi; ahih hangin tuipi in amau’ galte tumcip hi.
Amah in, a khut taklam tawh a ngahsa mual, a gam siangtho-ah amaute paipih hi.
Amah in, minamte, amau’ mai panin hawlkhia-in; amau’ luah ding neihsa hawmsak a, Israel minamte amau buk sungah teeng sak hi.
Ahi zongin amaute in Sangpen Pasian ze-etin lehdo uh a, ama teci pan’nate zui loin,
a pate uh mah bangin kiheikhia-in zuau gamtat uh hi; thal ginalo bangin amaute kihuiheek uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in amau’ munsangte tawh amah a sinso nadingin phin uh a, amau’ milim bawlte tawh ama hazat nading piangsak uh hi.
Pasian in a zak ciangin hehna tawh kidim a, amah in Israel nial siangtho hi.
Amah in, mihingte’ lak-a omna puanbuk, Shiloh khua-a a omna nusia a,
ama vangliatna, galte’ tungah ap a, ama minthan’na galte’ khutah pia hi.
Amah in, a mite, namsau tawh sisak a, ama luahte tungah a hehna nga hi.
Mei in amau tangvalte kangtum a, amau nungakte a ten’pih ding kuamah om nawn lo hi.
Amau siampite, namsau in puksak a, amau zite in kah zo lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin, Topa pen, zu kham-a awng mi thahatpa, a ihmu tho bangin khanglo hi.
Amah in, a langpangte zo a, a maizum tawntung dingin amaute koih hi.
Amah in, Josef’ puanbuk nial a, Efraim minamte teel lo hi;
ahih hangin, ama it, Zion Mual, Judah minam a teel hi.
Amah in, kip den dinga a phuhsa leitang, van sangpi bangin, ama biakinn a lam hi.
Amah in, ama mite ahi Jakob, ama gamluah ahi Israel a cing dingin, no a nei tuupite a cin’na, tuubukte panin la-in, ama nasem David a teel hi.
Amah in, lungsim thutang tawh amaute cingin, a siam mahmah a khut tawh amaute lam lak hi.
